fields.name: job_interview_stage_id
fields.description: Id of the `job_interview_stage` this slot belongs to (the section of the job's interview plan, e.g. "Onsite").

fields.name: job_id
fields.description: Id of the job whose interview plan this slot is defined on.

fields.name: sort_order
fields.description: Position of this slot within its `job_interview_stage`, ascending. The first interview in the stage is `1`.

fields.name: scheduling_type
fields.description: How the slot is fulfilled when a candidate hits the stage. `needs_scheduling` is a calendared interview that coordinators book against candidate availability; `take_home_test` is an asynchronous test sent through Greenhouse; `offer` is the offer step; `none` is a feedback-only slot (no scheduling). `null` for legacy steps with no scheduling type set.

fields.name: duration
fields.description: Default length of the interview in minutes, used to seed the scheduler. `null` if not set on the slot.

fields.name: summary
fields.description: Candidate-facing summary copied from the interview's default Interview Prep when the slot was added to the job. Snapshot only — edits made later in the job's Interview Kit are not reflected here; use the Interview Kits endpoint for the live value.

fields.name: instructions
fields.description: Interviewer-facing instructions copied from the interview's default Interview Prep when the slot was added to the job. Snapshot only — edits made later in the job's Interview Kit are not reflected here; use the Interview Kits endpoint for the live value.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the interview slot as it appears on the job's interview plan (e.g. "Recruiter Phone Screen", "Hiring Manager Interview").

fields.name: active
fields.description: Whether the slot is on the job's current interview plan. Inactive slots are retained for historical interviews that were scheduled against them but are not used for new applications.

fields.name: require_scorecard
fields.description: Whether interviewers must submit a scorecard for interviews scheduled against this slot. Only meaningful for `needs_scheduling` and `take_home_test` slots; `null` for `none` and `offer` slots, which never collect scorecards.
